Ensuring occupational safety and health, cooperating with the occupational safety and health department and supervisors. **This is the right job for you if:** ------------------------------------- * You have experience working in a warehouse. * You have experience using a scanner (preferred). * You speak Polish fluently. * Have basic computer skills. * You're open to shift work, including night shifts * You’re meticulous - at Allegro, we prioritize quality and attention to detail. * You’re willing to work shifts. * You enjoy collaborating with others - we work as a team every day. **What we offer:** ------------------ * Employment contract. * Multikafeteria (MyBenefit): A monthly pool of points to be used for selected benefits, including medical care (Medicover, Luxmed), sports cards (MultiSport, MedicoverSport), transportation allowances, and life and accident insurance for children. * Well-being and Health Support: Access to the Mindgram platform, which offers psychological support and care from specialists (24/7), as well as initiatives under the Health Campaign and the MWBO (Mind Well-Being Officer) program. * Development and education: A wide range of training courses on the MindUp platform, internal mentoring, coaching for leaders, and language courses (including English). * Subsidies and the Company Social Benefits Fund (ZFŚS): Benefits from the Company Social Benefits Fund (including vacation subsidies, housing loans, and financial assistance), as well as subsidies for prescription eyeglasses and contact lenses. * Employee Perks: Free Allegro Smart! deliveries, discretionary bonuses (the “I Appreciate You” award), additional days off for team-building activities, and employee volunteering. * Work as part of a team whose support you can always count on—we have the best specialists and experts in their fields on board. And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here. **#goodtobehere** means that: * You will be responsible for shaping the experiences of millions of customers by influencing the creation of new solutions and building Allegro One processes from scratch. * You will learn on the job, cooperating with true experts. You will receive support in continuous improvement and an environment where mistakes are treated as a learning opportunity. You will be responsible for supporting the sustainable growth of our business, actively contributing to environmental care. Send us your CV and… see you at Allegro! **Don’t wait until you join us! Let's meet online!** ---------------------------------------------------- Get to know our team, take a peek at our office life and check out what else we do at Allegro.

description: **Job Title: Editor, Macmillan Polska** **Fixed Term Contract, Full Time** **Location: Warsaw - Hybrid working model** **Applications Deadline: 16** **th** **November 2026** **About Springer Nature** Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and @SpringerNature. **About The Brand** Macmillan Education provides world-class content in the most relevant, engaging and flexible formats to support students, teachers and institutions in lifelong learning. The role sits within the structures of Macmillan Polska, the leading provider of ELT (English Language Teaching) educational materials custom made for the needs of the Polish students and teachers. Visit https://www.macmillan.pl/ and follow @MacmillanPolska, @MacmillanEducation / @MacmillanELT **About the Role** Working directly on assigned editorial content and monitoring the work of external contractors. As an Editor you are responsible for developing and managing educational publishing projects from developed manuscript to publication, including market-informed layout planning, proofreading, editorial oversight, and collaboration with external suppliers to deliver high-quality products that meet curriculum and customer needs. The location(s) strategy supports team structure and aligns business needs. **Role responsibilities:** * Manage educational publishing projects from concept through to publication, applying strong project and stakeholder management skills to ensure delivery to agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards. * Monitor developments in the Polish education system and ELT market, using pedagogical knowledge, resourcefulness, and market awareness to inform publishing plans and content development. * Collaborate effectively with authors, consultants, and internal stakeholders throughout the editorial and production process, demonstrating excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. * Apply strong editorial, writing, and proofreading skills to edit, review, and refine content, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and high editorial standards. * Commission and manage external contributors, including reviewers, editors, proofreaders, designers, and other suppliers, using effective project management, communication, and relationship-building skills. * Prepare clear editorial briefs and oversee the visual development of publications, leveraging editorial expertise, creativity, and attention to detail to support high-quality educational resources. * Manage copyright permissions, contributor agreements, and project documentation, utilising publishing workflows and systems and maintaining strong standards of quality management and compliance. * Support market research, piloting activities, and product evaluation, applying pedagogical understanding, analytical thinking, and resourcefulness to ensure publications meet customer and curriculum needs. * Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Production teams, using effective communication, stakeholder management, and technology skills to support successful product launches. Present project updates, insights, and recommendations to internal stakeholders, demonstrating strong communication, project management, and continuous improvement mindsets while contributing to the ongoing development of publishing programmes. **Skills, Experience & Qualifications:** *Essential* * Excellent written and verbal English, with outstanding attention to detail. * Strong editorial, copy-editing and proofreading skills. * Sound understanding of ELT methodology and pedagogy and the ability to evaluate educational content for linguistic accuracy, level appropriacy and pedagogical effectiveness. * Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work to agreed deadlines. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with authors, freelancers and cross-functional publishing teams. * Sound editorial judgement, problem-solving skills and a strong commitment to quality. * Confidence using digital tools and the ability to adapt to evolving publishing technologies and workflows. *Desirable* * Previous experience in ELT or educational publishing. * Degree or equivalent qualification in English, linguistics, education, ELT or a related discipline. * ELT teaching qualification and/or English-language teaching experience. * Knowledge of the Polish education system, curriculum, examination requirements and ELT market. * Experience of print and digital educational content and publishing workflows. * Experience of working with external editorial suppliers. Familiarity with AI-assisted editorial tools and responsible AI-supported content development. **To apply, please submit:** * a CV A cover letter - outlining your key ambitions for the role, and current notice period. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish. title: Part 145 engineer
description: Reach Beyond!: CHC provides unmatched helicopter services that enable our customers to reach beyond – to work in remote and challenging destinations that limit others – and come home safely. We are dedicated to our purpose of getting our customers where they need to be, when they need to be there, anywhere in the world – safely and reliably. All you have to do is get on board! At CHC, we pride ourselves on our values and culture: **Accountability:** Take pride and ownership of our actions and results. **Collaboration:** Working together with transparency and trust to drive continuous improvement. **Care:** Creating a safe and sustainable environment for all. **Integrity:** Doing what's right and fostering a culture of respect. **Excellence:** Prioritizing quality services and setting industry standards. Role Summary: Heli-One is a division of CHC Helicopter, the world’s largest helicopter services company. Heli-One’s Poland facility in Jasionka near Rzeszow is focusing on airframe maintenance, repairs and services of “heavy” helicopters in the CHC fleet as well as external customers. The company completes repair and overhaul services for customers internationally. All our global sites are outfitted with state-of-the-art equipment and staffed with expert technicians. The successful candidate will be responsible for technical support for aircrafts being under maintenance. You will be part of a team of 8 people and as the Technical Content Administrator you will be responsible for generating and editing technical content. You will work closely with subject matter experts (SMEs) and editors throughout the company. Key Responsibilities: * Creating work orders templates for aircraft SOW – scope of work tasks * Responses to technical queries raised by Mechanic * Contact with aircraft OEM, aircraft CAMO and design offices for requested technical support * Creating internal engineering instructions * Verification of aircraft, aircraft components AD status * Support for AC Maintenance quotation process * Cooperation with planning department * Technical support for Project Manager requests * Technical support for implementation of new capabilities (New AC types, components) Qualifications, Skills & Attributes: * A University Degree in technical discipline * Good technical knowledge about aircraft maintenance standards * Experience in maintenance, minimum 1 year * Knowledge about Part 145 requirements * Fluency in Polish and English is essential * Self-motivated and results oriented * Excellent listening, verbal and written communication and presentation skills * Ability to lead in a rapidly evolving and dynamic environment * Strong analytical skills to interpret research data for reports and apply mathematic techniques in practical situations * Ability to work on several projects or issues simultaneously * Demonstrated team player with excellent interpersonal skills * Able to work as part of a team **Eligibility** Applicants must have the legal right to work in Poland and meet any clearance requirements relevant to the role. **Important Information** * ️ **All CVs and application materials must be submitted in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.** **Recruitment Process** We reserve the right to commence interviews or close this vacancy before the advertised closing date should suitable candidates be identified. We therefore encourage early applications. The deadline for applying is 20th November 2026. Due to the high volume of applications received, we are unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. If you do not receive a response from our recruitment team, please consider your application unsuccessful on this occasion. We sincerely appreciate your interest in CHC & Heli-One and encourage you to monitor our careers website for future opportunities that match your skills and experience. **Recruitment Agencies** This position is managed directly by CHC & Heli-One and we are not engaging recruitment agencies for this vacancy. We respectfully request that agencies do not contact us regarding this role or submit unsolicited candidate profiles. Any CV submitted without prior written agreement will be treated as a direct application and no agency fees will be payable. **We look forward to hearing from talented professionals!**

title: Junior AI/ML Engineer (GenAI, AWS)
description: * Provectus is an **AWS Premier Partner** and an **Anthropic Strategic Partner**, working at the frontier of applied AI. We help enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes — through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide. * Our work centers on two verticals — **Financial Services & Insurance** and **Healthcare & Life Sciences** — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture. * Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Blueprint engagements. **Where this role sits** ------------------------ You will work in a senior pod alongside an FDE, an FDX, and Senior AI Engineers — contributing to real delivery work while building toward independent ownership. ### **Requirements:** **Mindset** * Proactive and self-directed; you push for clarity rather than waiting for a ticket. * Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. * Comfortable with some ambiguity, with support from senior team members as you take on more. * B2+ English, comfortable collaborating across distributed, multicultural teams. **Technical depth** * Hands-on experience building or contributing to RAG systems, ideally in a production or near-production setting. * Solid engineering fundamentals; Python and/or TypeScript proficiency. Productive in an unfamiliar codebase with some ramp-up support. * Practical AWS experience (Lambda, S3, ECS, or similar); ready to grow into Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore . * Some experience with containers and CI/CD in real projects. * Exposure to evaluating non-deterministic systems — you've contributed to or run test/eval cycles, even if you haven't owned a full eval suite end-to-end. * Basic working knowledge of model/agent monitoring concepts. * Awareness of cost and latency trade-offs when working with LLMs. * Some hands-on exposure to the Claude ecosystem (Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files) is a plus, or strong ability to ramp up quickly. * Practical experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or OpenAI) in real projects. * 2+ years of software or ML engineering experience, including some exposure to production systems. * Solid AI/ML foundations — you understand what the models do well enough to reason about common failure modes. ### **Nice to Have:** * Experience in one of the industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare. * Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery. * AWS and Claude Code Certifications (or actively pursuing them). * A2A: Interest in agent-to-agent interoperability concepts. * CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). * Practical experience with one or more use cases from the following: NLP, LLMs, and Recommendation engines. * Experience in an additional language (Go, TypeScript, or Rust). * Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Kafkа. * Experience with the Claude ecosystem — Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files. Spec-driven development — writing the intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria before you let an agent build. * MCP: you can say why an agent would prefer it to a REST integration, having authored a server is an additional plus. ### **Responsibilities:** * Build and contribute to RAG system components under senior guidance, with growing autonomy. * Write tests and help build out evaluation harnesses for the features you work on. * Write production code across the stack (AI, backend services, data pipelines) with code review support. * Help integrate AI components into backend services and RESTful APIs. * Support deployment of systems to AWS (containerized, CI/CD), taking on more of this independently over time. * Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and client handover materials. * Participate in technical discussions and architectural decisions, with an eye toward taking on more of this independently. * Support model evaluation efforts and help investigate and improve failure modes. * Take on increasing ownership of components and technical decisions as you grow in the role. ### **What We Offer:** * The chance to shape how leading enterprises across LATAM, Europe, and North America adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment * A forward-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside FDE and FDX * A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them * Remote-friendly culture * Internal training programs with full support for Claude, AWS, and other professional certifications, conference attendance * Career growth; we actively develop our engineers * Access to the latest AI tools and premium subscriptions * Long-term B2B collaboration * Private medical insurance or a budget for your medical needs * Paid sick leave, vacation, and public holidays * Equipment and all the tech you need for comfortable, productive work ### **How we hire:** * Intro conversation. The role, your background and aspirations, tech questions. * Technical interview with live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor, you may use an LLM assistant * HR Interview. Soft skills and expectations * HM interview. Tech questions; a live engineering session is also possible We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. description: **Location:** Krakow, Lesser Poland, Poland **Job ID:** R0151089 **Date Posted:** 2026-11-05 **Company Name:** HITACHI ENERGY SERVICES SP. Z O.O. **Profession (Job Category):** Finance **Job Schedule:** Full time **Remote:** No **Job Description:** **The Opportunity:** We are excited to offer an opportunity for a skilled Fixed Assets Accountant Specialist to join our dynamic finance team at Hitachi Energy. This is not just a job; it's a chance to be part of a vibrant and collaborative environment where your contributions truly matter. You will be joining a well-structured team consisting of two GL teams and one FA team, with a total of 22 people. Our teams are split by countries and operate under the guidance of two Team Leaders, ensuring focused and efficient workflows. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced General Accounting Specialist who will be responsible for various accounting functions including journal entries, reconciliation, and month-end close. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a solid understanding of accounting principles. In this role, you will be responsible for performing general accounting activities, completing specific month-end close tasks, and executing accounting analyses and reports as assigned. You will ensure the production of various financial reports, including Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow, and reconciliation of tangible and intangible as-sets. In this role, you will be primarily responsible for fixed assets accounting. You will support the complete fixed asset lifecycle, including asset creation, capitalization, depreciation, transfers, disposals, impairment, reconciliation, and reporting. You will apply accounting techniques and standard practices to classify and record financial trans-actions, solving unusual issues as they arise. Close cooperation with controllers, Front Offices, and other streams (AP, AR, Master data) will be essential. Zwracanie uwagi na potrzeby naszej społeczności umożliwia nam optymalizację naszych możliwości rozwoju i pomaga zapewnić wiele dróg do sukcesu w Palantir. Promowanie zdrowia i dobrego samopoczucia we wszystkich obszarach życia pracowników firmy Palantir to tylko jeden ze sposobów inwestowania w naszą społeczność. Dowiedz się więcej na stronie* *Życie w Palantir* *i pamiętaj, że nasza oferta może się różnić w zależności od regionu.* *Wierzymy, że postępowanie zgodne z wartościami i kulturą firmy Palantir sprawia, iż pracownicy „lepiej współpracują ze sobą”, a praca osobista daje możliwość bardziej kreatywnych wyników. title: Senior Project Manager, CRM
description: We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For over 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity. *We work with people in over 150 countries and reach over 700 million people.* **We connect. We inspire.** **Role Description/Purpose** The British Council is seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Project Manager, CRM to lead the successful planning and delivery of high-impact CRM projects and initiatives. This role is responsible for ensuring the effective implementation, optimisation, and continuous evolution of CRM capabilities that support organisational objectives, strengthen customer engagement, and deliver measurable business value. As the Senior Project Manager, CRM, you will provide leadership across a portfolio of complex CRM projects and change initiatives, coordinating cross-functional teams and managing timelines, risks, dependencies, and resources to ensure successful delivery. You will be accountable for driving user adoption, ensuring customer-focused outcomes, and embedding best practice project governance across the CRM function. Working within the Marketing and Communications division, you will contribute to a strategic function that drives audience engagement, reputation, and growth through customer insight, data, digital channels, and impactful communications. The CRM team plays a critical role in enabling these activities by delivering technology solutions that support effective customer engagement and organisational performance. You will work closely with stakeholders across multiple functions, ensuring CRM solutions align with business needs and strategic priorities. The role requires the ability to balance operational delivery with long-term transformation objectives, helping to shape and enhance the British Council’s CRM landscape while supporting continuous improvement and innovation. The successful candidate will have significant project management experience, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to lead complex programmes of work in a fast-paced environment. You will be confident managing competing priorities, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving the successful delivery and adoption of CRM solutions that create lasting value for both customers and the organisation. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in the future development of the British Council’s CRM capabilities, leading strategic initiatives that enhance customer experience, strengthen engagement, and support organisational success on a global scale. **Role Accountabilities** As a Senior Project Manager, CRM, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of a portfolio of CRM projects, ensuring effective planning, governance, and delivery throughout the project lifecycle. You will oversee project scope, resources, risks, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and quality standards, ensuring that projects achieve agreed business outcomes while supporting improvements in customer experience and organisational performance. Working closely with a wide range of stakeholders, you will establish strong relationships with project sponsors, business leaders, end users, suppliers, and external partners to ensure successful project delivery and alignment with strategic priorities. You will lead cross-functional teams and specialist resources, creating a collaborative and high-performing environment that enables the successful delivery of complex CRM solutions. As a senior project leader, you will be responsible for implementing and maintaining robust project governance and management controls, including business cases, project plans, risk and issue management processes, quality assurance measures, dependency tracking, and benefits realisation frameworks. You will monitor project performance against agreed objectives and provide regular reporting, analysis, and recommendations to stakeholders and governance boards, ensuring proactive management of risks and delivery challenges. The role will oversee the full lifecycle of CRM initiatives, from requirements validation and solution development through to system integration, testing, user acceptance testing, data migration, implementation, and transition into business-as-usual operations. You will ensure that CRM projects are delivered in line with organisational strategy, technology roadmaps, operational processes, and governance standards while managing dependencies across multiple functions and teams. A key aspect of the role will be driving stakeholder engagement and organisational change. You will work closely with business users to ensure projects deliver meaningful and sustainable improvements, with particular focus on change management, user adoption, communications, training, and the successful embedding of new ways of working. You will help ensure that technology solutions are fully adopted and deliver their intended benefits across the organisation. The successful candidate will have extensive project management experience, strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, and a proven ability to deliver complex business and technology change programmes. You will be comfortable working in fast-paced environments, managing competing priorities, influencing senior stakeholders, and leading multidisciplinary teams to achieve successful outcomes. You will also act as a champion for project management best practice, ensuring all work is delivered in accordance with British Council quality standards, governance requirements, established methodologies, and compliance obligations. **Qualifications & Experience** **Essentials** * Degree or professional qualification in digital marketing, technology or business. or demonstrable level of equivalent experience. * Professional project management qualification(s), such as APMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Waterfall etc. * Language Requirements: The British Council systems and global processes operate in English. Written and verbal proficiency in English is required. * Significant experience with system development and rollouts in an international context. * Demonstrable experience of leading the delivery of large projects or programme strands across a major part of an organisation and across a significant geographical area. * Demonstrates the ability to plan, structure and manage the ‘hard scope’ of a programme that delivers tangible outputs (eg documents, systems, assets). **Desirable:** * Experience of delivering projects within both public and private sectors (corporate). * Experience of developing and quality assuring the business requirement / project specification, and testing against it (technical testing and user acceptance). * Experience with development and rollout of CRM/Customer data systems. * Experience within a global organisation. **Important Information** * **Contract type** : Indefinite Contract * **Salary:** The starting salary for this role is PLN 16,300.00 per month. The final compensation package will be determined based on the successful candidate’s skills, qualifications, and relevant experience. * **Working Model:** Hybrid. British Council supports working in new ways such as hybrid working, subject to full approval by line management and conditional upon our ability to provide the appropriate level of service. This may not be appropriate for all roles but can be explored at interview. * **Location:** This role can be based in Warsaw or Kraków, Poland. * **Annual Leave entitlement:** Employees are entitled to 20 working days of annual leave per calendar year, increasing to 26 working days per calendar year upon reaching 10 years of qualifying service. * **Proof of Identity requirements & right to work in the country** : Applicants must have the legal right to work in Poland. **Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not provided.** * **Start Date:** March 2027. * **Benefits:** + Annual bonus equivalent to a 13th month's salary (subject to eligibility and performance requirements). + Private medical care through Enel-Med. + MultiSport card co-funded through the Social Fund. + Discounts on British Council English courses and examinations for employees and their immediate family members. + Access to Social Fund benefits, including financial grants and holiday subsidies, where applicable. + Employee Assistance Programme. + Ongoing professional development and the opportunity to explore diverse career paths across the organisation. **Closing Date: Thursday 19 November 2026** A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world. **Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Statement** We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and we welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability, and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent and we guarantee an interview for disabled applicants who meet the minimum role requirements. We welcome discussions about specific requirements or adjustments to enable participation and engagement in our work and activities. **Safeguarding Statement** The British Council is committed to safeguarding children, young people, and adults who we work with. We believe that all children and adults everywhere in the world deserve to live in safe environments and have the right to be protected from all forms of abuse, maltreatment and exploitation as set out in article 19, UNCRC (United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child) 1989. Appointment to positions where there is direct involvement with vulnerable groups will be dependent on thorough checks being completed in line with legal requirements and with the British Council’s Safeguarding policies for Adults and Children. We provide access to 36 derivatives exchanges, 175 foreign exchange markets, nearly every global securities marketplace and a number of bi-lateral liquidity venues. Our clients use our institutional-grade digital platforms, our high-touch service, and our market intelligence to pursue trading opportunities, make investments efficiently, manage their market risks, and improve their business performance. Our relentless focus on helping them accomplish these objectives has enabled us to build deeply valued, long-term relationships based on guidance, integrity, transparency, and trust. SFL is a solo-regulated firm, authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA). Under the Senior Managers and Certification Regime (“SMCR”), SFL is an Enhanced Firm. Responsibilities: **Job purpose** To support the EMEA Financial Crime Oversight, Assurance & Testing (OAT) function through the execution of assurance reviews, control testing, thematic assessments and remediation validation activities, providing independent assurance over the effectiveness of Financial Crime controls. The role will contribute to the development and enhancement of OAT methodologies, assurance frameworks, testing libraries, reporting processes and governance standards, helping to establish a consistent and effective assurance capability across the EMEA region. **General Duties** * Conduct risk-based assurance reviews, thematic reviews and control testing activities across the EMEA Financial Crime framework. * Assess the design and operating effectiveness of financial crime controls, identifying control weaknesses, emerging risks and opportunities for improvement. * Perform walkthroughs, sampling, evidence gathering and testing activities in accordance with the approved OAT methodology and assurance standards. * Prepare and maintain high-quality working papers, testing documentation, findings reports and supporting evidence to ensure a clear and auditable review trail. * Validate remediation actions arising from assurance reviews, regulatory findings, internal audit findings and other control deficiencies. * Contribute to the development and maintenance of assurance methodologies, testing scripts, working paper templates, evidence standards and review toolkits. * Support the preparation of assurance reporting, management information, thematic analysis and governance committee materials. * Assist in the development and delivery of the Annual Risk-Based Assurance & Testing Plan through execution of assigned reviews and testing activities. * Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of OAT policies, procedures, frameworks and governance standards. * Support management, MLROs and other stakeholders with assurance-related information requests, regulatory remediation activities, deep-dive reviews and thematic assessments. * Develop and maintain effective working relationships with Operations, Compliance, Risk, Technology, Internal Audit, local MLROs and other stakeholders to promote a strong financial crime control environment. * Monitor regulatory developments, industry guidance and emerging financial crime risks, ensuring relevant considerations are incorporated into assurance activities where appropriate. * Support regulatory examinations, internal audits and external reviews by providing information, documentation and subject matter expertise as required. * Undertake any other duties and responsibilities reasonably required by management from time to time. Qualifications: **Knowledge and Experience** * Good understanding of AML, CTF, sanctions, anti-bribery and corruption principles and the application of a risk-based approach to financial crime prevention. * Previous experience in AML, Compliance, Financial Crime Prevention, Quality Assurance, Oversight, Risk Management or Control Testing functions within a regulated financial services environment. * Ideally 3-5 years of experience in AML, Financial Crime Compliance, Quality Assurance, Assurance, Risk or related control functions. * Good understanding of customer due diligence, ongoing monitoring, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, periodic reviews and financial crime control frameworks. * Knowledge of UK and EU AML regulatory requirements, including FCA expectations, Money Laundering Regulations, JMLSG guidance, FATF standards and relevant EU AML frameworks. * Understanding of assurance, quality assurance, control testing, findings management, remediation validation and risk-based monitoring principles would be advantageous. **Qualification and Skills** * Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Law, or other appropriate discipline. * Strong and efficient decision-making skills with the ability to use judgement and operate autonomously when required. * Effective planning, organisational and time management skills. * Relationship building and communications skills. * Excellent stakeholder management with the ability to see the bigger picture and deal effectively with competing priorities. * Ability to proactively identify and analyse problems and design effective solutions. * Ability to lead and manage people and achieve results through others. * Able to use good judgement and experience to articulate and document decision making rationale. * Additional language skills would be an advantage in our global business environment.

title: Creative Marketing Project Coordinator
description: **CapsLock** is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions. At **CapsLock**, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success. **﻿Role overview** Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly. You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow. If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process. **Responsibilities** **Task & Pipeline Management** * Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system). * Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member * Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch * Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage **Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up** * Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers * Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline * Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them * Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed **Quality Control** * Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications * Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live * Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context * Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals **Reporting & Documentation** * Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned * Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools * Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards **Process Improvement & AI** * Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow * Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy * Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes **Creative Collaboration** * Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas * Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks * Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time Requirements: **Must-Have Skills** * Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking * Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks * Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly * Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy * Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content **Technical Skills** * 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management * Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello * Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work * Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus * Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher **Soft Skills** * Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems * Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines * Clear, professional communicator * Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team * Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas **What we offer** * **Remote Work -** We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact. * **Paid vacations** - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge * **Unlimited Sick Days** - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet. * **Ongoing Learning** - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more. * **Home Office** -We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience. * **Physical Well–Being** - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program. * **Fun Stuff** - There is never a shortage of fun stuff

title: Quality Specialist

Each day, you will assist the organization in achieving the right mix of prevention, continuous improvement, robust root cause analysis, quick response, and sustainable solutions to problems. You will also showcase your expertise by collaborating with local functions that impact the quality results to reach the targets for the organizational unit and aim for world-class performance. The work model for the role is: **hybrid / remote**. This role is contributing to the **Building Automation Business Line**. Main stakeholders are **customers, manufacturing and operations teams, product management, compliance and regulatory functions, and cross-functional quality working groups.** **You will be mainly accountable for:** * Ensure timely resolution of quality issues affecting customers, production, suppliers, or other stakeholders * Ensure effective root cause analysis and implementation of regulatory obligations * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify risks and drive quality-related risk management activities * Monitor and analyze quality data and drive improvement on main engineering, or quality management**, ideally working with **electrical products or KNX systems**. * You are skilled in identifying critical quality issues, assessing their impact, and escalating them appropriately to senior management and key stakeholders. * You are passionate about customer focus, professional communication, structured problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and assurance and testing methodologies**, knowledge of **Product Compliance**, and familiarity with **AI tools in quality processes** would be an advantage. * You are at ease communicating in English (required). That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: ### **Who are we?** Newcode helps legal organizations build, govern, and deploy AI workflows connected to their knowledge and existing systems. Our Aurora workflow platform enables teams to turn firm expertise into repeatable workflows that operate within the firm’s technology environment. ### **The role** You'll own the backend behind our AI features. That's the APIs, the data pipelines, and the orchestration sitting between our product and the language models doing the work. In practice it means running retrieval over large sets of documents, getting dependable results out of LLMs and their tool calls, streaming responses to the UI, and processing long jobs in the background without things falling over. It isn't CRUD work. The hard parts here are keeping AI systems accurate and fast with confidential data, at production scale. You'll make architecture calls early and live with them. **Requirements** **Turn how legal work gets done into AI workflows lawyers trust** Newcode helps legal organizations build, govern, and deploy AI workflows connected to their knowledge and existing systems. Our Aurora workflow platform enables teams to turn firm expertise into repeatable workflows that operate within the firm's technology environment. Our clients are law firms and professional-services teams. They know exactly where their work is slow, repetitive, or risky. What they don't know is how to turn that into an AI workflow they can trust with real client work. We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to do exactly that. This role reports to the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering. ### **The Opportunity** You'll work directly with clients to understand how their work actually gets done, and then build it in Aurora, our visual AI workflow builder. Aurora is low-code. You design flows by connecting components on a canvas, configure the models, prompts, document search, and integrations, and write a short script where the canvas stops. The hard part isn't the code. It's understanding a messy process well enough to break it into steps a model can do reliably, seeing where it will fail before it does, and showing a skeptical partner at a law firm that it works. This role rewards judgment and engineering discipline more than seniority. We care more about how you think than how many years you've written code. You need to be comfortable with hands-on technical work. For example, you can read API documentation to connect two systems, edit JSON files, write a short Python function when the canvas is not enough, and find out why a flow stopped working. ### **How the team works** You'll report to the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, who manages the FDEs across our client pods and owns engineering quality, staffing, coaching, and technical delivery practices. What you will own * Sit with clients alongside the senior legal engineer and map how a piece of work gets done today: the inputs, the decisions, the exceptions, and who signs off. * Turn the workflow requirements into working flows in Aurora, such as document intake, clause extraction, contract review, drafting, and multi-step agents. * Configure the building blocks: prompts, model choice, search over client documents, and connections to the systems clients already use, within each firm's access controls and confidentiality boundaries. * Write python scripts where configuration isn't enough, such as a custom component, a data transformation, or an API call, and flag the ones worth reusing across clients. * Test every flow against real examples and the evals agreed with the firm, find where it fails, and fix it before a client finds it. Show with evidence against the legal acceptance criteria, not a demo, that it works. * Run workshops and pilots, help deliver the AI Academy for each firm's Aurora users, and stay responsible for the flow after it goes live, with a named owner and support plan agreed before release. * Follow the FDE team's delivery playbook and technical standards, including design and code reviews, testing, traceability, monitoring, and human review suited to each flow's intended use. * Give realistic estimates, and raise scope changes, risks, and dependencies early with the senior legal engineer and the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering. * Bring what you learn back, through the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, to Product and Engineering as patterns rather than anecdotes: missing features in Aurora, recurring requests and how often they come up, and bugs. * Help the team track delivery time, effort, workflow adoption, and component reuse, so that estimates and client outcomes improve over time. ### **What you bring** * You think in structure. Give you a vague process and you break it into clear steps, inputs, and decisions, and you see where it will go wrong. * You learn a new domain fast. You don't need a law degree, but you'll want to understand how a lawyer reviews a contract or runs a due diligence. * You explain things clearly to a law firm partner and to an engineer, and you're honest about what AI can and can't do. * You work well in a small team. You take the legal requirements from the senior legal engineer, hold your work to the team's engineering standards, and ask for review early rather than late. * At least three years in a technical, client-facing role, for example solutions engineer, implementation consultant, technical consultant, automation specialist, or developer. * Hands-on experience configuring or building in a technical tool: workflow automation, integrations, a low-code platform, or software development. * You can read and write simple scripts in Python, work with JSON and REST APIs, and debug what you built. * You use LLMs every day and have a view on prompting, where models are reliable, and where they aren't. * You're fine in a startup that changes direction. Decisions get made, then revisited, and direction changes to meet the goal. * Fluent in English. ### **Additional experience we value** * Experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate, or a similar workflow tool. * Experience building LLM applications, retrieval (RAG), or agents. * A background in law, consulting, audit, finance, engineering or another professional-services field. * Experience with document management systems such as iManage or SharePoint. * Experience with law-firm constraints such as matter permissions and ethical walls. * Experience with Microsoft Azure. * We value demonstrated capability over a particular degree or job title. ### **What success looks like** In your first 30 days, you know Aurora well enough to build, test, and debug a flow on your own, you have joined a client pod, and you have taken part in a discovery workshop and an AI Academy session. By 60 days, you are building and testing flows on at least one active deployment, following the delivery playbook, with evals, release criteria, and support ownership in place. By 90 days, you deliver repeatably across multiple clients, and the lawyers and firm technology teams you work with trust your flows with real client work. ### **Location** Hybrid from one of the locations only: Oslo, Norway; Wroclaw, Poland; or Chicago, United States, 3 days per week in the office. Expect client travel of roughly 25% typically for discovery workshops, pilots, and go-live support. Collaboration with distributed colleagues across time zones, including the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering in Chicago, is part of the role. ### **Why join Newcode** At Newcode.ai, we specialize in making law firms AI-native through a configurable AI harness designed for the realities of legal work. Achieving that mission takes more than powerful technology: it requires exceptional people who can understand how lawyers work, configure solutions around their needs, and help them realize the immense value AI can create. As part of our collaborative, high-growth team, you'll work side by side with visionary founders at the forefront of AI and legal innovation, shaping both our product and the definition of AI native legal work. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work directly with clients on AI that ends up in real legal work, not in a demo. You'll help shape how we deploy Aurora, contributing to the Aurora playbook and the field patterns that make it into the product, and you'll grow with regular coaching from the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, clear technical standards, and a team that delivers repeatably rather than through individual heroics. We believe in being transparent about what it's like to work at Newcode.ai. As a fast-growing startup, we're building and evolving every day. That means not every process, playbook, or framework is already in place, and priorities can shift quickly. The people who thrive here are comfortable with ambiguity, take ownership, and don't wait for perfect direction. They are resourceful, proactive, and able to "figure it out", solving problems, creating structure where needed, and helping build the company as they go. If you are good with this, great! Keep reading to learn more. **Company stage.** Newcode is a growth-stage legal AI company founded in 2021. It has moved beyond early product validation into scaling deployments and expanding in the U.S. The company describes its product as a configurable AI platform that connects a firm's data, systems, and workflows, with controls for permissions, models, and deployment. **Funding.** Newcode has a total funding of $20 million. The Series A was led by OnDean Forward, with participation from The LegalTech Fund, Antiportfolio Ventures, Relativity's investment arm Rel Labs, and existing investors. **Traction and deployments.** Today Newcode serves more than 100 law firms and government agencies in Europe and the United States, with annual recurring revenue more than tripling over the prior 12 months. Check out our webpage for our most recent customers. **Why now is a compelling time to join.** Newcode is at an exciting stage of growth. With fresh Series A funding and strong customer and revenue growth, we are investing in the next chapter of our growth in Europe and the U.S. Our platform is moving beyond standalone AI tools and into the everyday workflows of leading legal teams. From firmwide deployments to integrated legal research, we are helping customers put AI to work on meaningful, real-world challenges. As we expand our product, customer support, go-to-market, and partnerships, you will have the opportunity to take on important work and help shape how we grow. You will join a global team of more than 60 people, with the scale to serve major organizations and the agility to make a visible impact. If you are excited to build practical AI for the legal industry and help shape a company's next stage of growth, this is a great time to join Newcode. **Benefits** We offer competitive salary, **equity**, and bonus across all locations. Benefits are tailored to each country to meet local requirements and market practice: * **US (Chicago):** Medical, dental, and vision; 401(k); paid time off; * **Norway (Oslo) and Poland (Wrocław):** Statutory benefits plus local offerings, including pension, paid leave, and parental leave ### **The hiring process** * Stage 1: Screening call (15 minutes) * Stage 2: Case assessment: design and build a flow for a realistic client problem (1 hours) * Stage 3: Presentation of your case to the team, including the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering (3 hours) * Stage 4: CEO interview (15 minutes) Newcode is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants of all backgrounds. **Visa Sponsorship:** At this time, Newcode is unable to provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the applicable country without employer sponsorship.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (Mandarin-Speaking)
description: **About Revolut** People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. **About the role** Enterprise Sales is where Revolut Business partners with global businesses to empower them to accept payments, manage currencies, and move money internationally on one platform. We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to identify, win, and expand relationships with prospective enterprise accounts. You’ll be partnering with C-suite leadership to modernise their financial operations, leveraging product knowledge to drive feature adoption and growth. Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch. **What you'll be doing** * Owning the full sales cycle, including sourcing, getting the customer live, and expanding the account long term * Building relationships and maximising adoption opportunities for multi-currency accounts, payment acceptance, global money movement, etc. * Using a consultative sales approach to understand customer needs, collaborating with Product Owners and Product Sales Specialists to provide holistic solutions * Activating new customers as well as nurturing and expanding existing customer relationships * Becoming a public champion for Revolut within the enterprise domain, and being a part of the team’s expansion * Managing and developing a strategic enterprise sales pipeline **What you'll need** * Fluency in English * Fluency in Mandarin * 5+ years of enterprise sales experience in payments, banking, or fintech * An in-depth understanding of payments, treasury, FX, acquiring, issuing, or broader financial infrastructure * A track record of quota overachievement on multi-stakeholder deals with long sales cycles * The ability to understand customer business models, spot opportunities, and build financial cases you can defend * Sharp analytical skills and genuine curiosity * Solid prospecting skills with the ability to generate your own pipeline and build a territory from scratch * The ability to shift from strategic planning to supporting customers with initial account set up and through the first weeks of getting started **Nice to have** * Existing relationships with enterprise finance, treasury, or payments decision-makers * Experience managing global enterprise accounts across multiple markets * Familiarity with launching a product or sales motion in a new market * The ability to travel for meetings, conferences, and industry events if local policies and guidelines permit * Fluency in other languages **Compensation range** * Poland: PLN12,500 - PLN20,600 gross monthly\* * Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process * Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience *Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.* ***Important notice for candidates:*** *Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.* * ***Only apply through official Revolut channels.*** *We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.* * ***Always double-check the emails you receive.*** *Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.* ***We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.*** *If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.* *By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. description: EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions helping industrial, infrastructure and defense customers address critical power and operational needs. The company delivers integrated solutions that combine energy storage technologies, power electronics, software-enabled intelligence, technical expertise and comprehensive global customer support. EnerSys supports customers across communications networks, data centers, energy infrastructure, material handling, transportation, aerospace and defense — including applications where power continuity is essential. Serving customers in more than 100 countries, EnerSys helps organizations manage energy more reliably, efficiently and intelligently in complex operating environments where uptime, safety and resilience matter. **Supporting Critical Operations Through Three Specialized Business Platforms:** * **Network & Infrastructure Solutions (NIS)** - Powering the connected world with trusted reserve power and critical infrastructure solutions. * **Industrial Mobility Solutions (IMS)** - Powering industrial vehicles and equipment that keep essential goods and industries moving around the world. * **Precision Power Solutions (PPS)** - Powering advanced, reliable, high-performance solutions for defense, aerospace, and specialized applications. **Job Purpose** --------------- Enable the growth of EnerSys’ commercial and industrial BESS business in Europe by combining market knowledge and technical sales support with practical experience in project delivery. Act as the internal technical lead from opportunity assessment through customer handover, defining scope, selecting qualified external partners and coordinating site assessment, permitting, installation and commissioning. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- * Assess customer sites and requirements with sales teams and external specialists. Identify technical feasibility, connection requirements, site constraints and installation risks before commercial commitments are made. * Identify the site-specific permitting and approval pathway with local specialists, customers and relevant authorities or network operators. Coordinate submissions and track approvals, with responsibilities clearly agreed between the parties. * Develop and qualify a network of engineering consultants, electrical installers, civil works contractors, lifting providers and commissioning partners in priority markets. Define scopes, deliverables, interfaces and selection criteria. * Coordinate electrical design, site preparation, delivery, lifting and positioning with qualified partners, ensuring site readiness and completion of required technical sign-offs. * Manage project scope, schedule, installation budget, contractor performance and risks through commissioning, acceptance testing and customer handover. * Review quotations with sales and finance to ensure that engineering, permits, installation, commissioning, exclusions and contingencies are properly reflected. Provide technical input to customer proposals and supplier or contractor offers. * Maintain knowledge of BESS applications, competitors and customer economics. Support sales teams with customer meetings, solution selection, business cases and clear explanations of system value and delivery requirements. * Work with Product Management, Engineering, Operations and Service to confirm solution suitability, resolve technical issues and provide market feedback. Establish reusable site assessment tools, partner scopes, checklists and handover documentation. * Coordinate training and service handover so local teams understand operating requirements, maintenance responsibilities and escalation routes. Share project lessons to improve subsequent deployments. **Experience & Qualifications** ------------------------------- * Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Energy Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant technical experience. * Proven involvement in successfully installed and commissioned stationary BESS projects, preferably for commercial and industrial customers in Europe. Candidates must demonstrate their personal role in coordinating delivery and managing external partners. * Practical experience with permitting and connection processes, electrical integration, contractor selection, project costing and site execution. Ability to recognise when specialist or locally authorised expertise is required. * Sound understanding of batteries, power conversion, energy management systems and grid-connected applications, together with the ability to review electrical diagrams and challenge technical proposals. * Commercial awareness, including BESS use cases, energy economics, quotation review and customer business cases. Ability to support sales while identifying delivery constraints and risks. * Strong project coordination, communication and supplier management skills; able to work across countries and functions. Fluent English; additional European languages are an advantage. Willingness to travel regularly. * Experience in warehouse, logistics, manufacturing, or industrial operations. **Initial priorities and measures of success** ---------------------------------------------- Establish the delivery approach and qualified partner coverage in selected European markets; progress initial customer projects through approvals, installation and commissioning; and create a repeatable process for subsequent deployments. Success will be measured by predictable project costs and schedules, quality and safety of execution, customer acceptance and effective support for profitable sales. title: Compliance Controls & Governance Senior Specialist
description: Poland - Warsaw - HQ Full-time Permanent employee **What we do?** --------------- UniCredit in Poland belongs to one of the largest financial groups in Europe, serving over 20 million Clients, including one million businesses. We are building a new banking model that combines the speed and appeal of a fintech with the strength and stability of a universal bank. We draw on 150 years of experience and the unique expertise of our teams, acting as the Group’s pan-European innovation hub. We are creating ultra-fast and transparent banking with an “all-in-one” application and new opportunities for all Clients - individual, business, and corporate. We provide full omnichannel service thanks to a network of flagship branches in key Polish cities and our Support Center. Our greatest value is our People - a Team of creative experts who thrive in a dynamic and innovative environment. We focus on collaboration, engagement, and achieving ambitious goals. We are looking for a **Compliance Controls & Governance Senior Specialist** to join us at this pivotal moment, share our vision, and help shape the future of European banking. **What you will be doing?** --------------------------- **Role Purpose** **Compliance Controls & Governance Senior Specialist** is responsible for executing, monitoring, and enhancing second-line controls across the Four branches. Controls will be mainly focused on Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) and Sanction topics. The role ensures that activities across branch locations comply with applicable regulations, internal control frameworks, and Group compliance policies. The candidate will be responsible for Risk Assessment activities, management reporting, and the cascading of Group policies and procedures to local Compliance Officers. The role requires a broad cross-country perspective, including oversight of key activities, remediation plans, and emerging issues to ensure a consolidated view of Compliance/AFC risks. **Key Responsibilities** **Second-Line Control Execution & Monitoring** * Execute, tailor, and formalize Second Level controls testing across multiple branches and jurisdictions. * Identify control deficiencies, gaps, and emerging compliance risks, drafting clear findings and recommending appropriate remediation actions. * Monitor and validate remediation plans to ensure timely and effective risk mitigation. * Report control testing results and key findings to both Group and Local functions. **Reporting, Data & Governance** * Prepare regular Management Information (MI), dashboards, risk metrics, and reports for local and Group Compliance Committees, the Head of Controls, and senior management. * Support the execution of Risk Assessments and the calibration of annual control testing plans across branch entities. * Act as the primary liaison with Data and IT teams regarding data extractions, reporting requirements, data quality, and control-testing methodologies. * Drive continuous improvements in governance processes, risk assessment methodologies, management reporting, and control frameworks. * Leverage data and analytical insights to identify trends, emerging risks, control weaknesses, and opportunities for enhancement. **Governance & Policy Management** * Cascade Group policies, procedures, standards, and regulatory updates to local Compliance teams, supporting their implementation and ensuring ongoing compliance. * Coordinate with local Compliance Officers and Group stakeholders to ensure consistent application of Compliance and AFC requirements across all jurisdictions. **Skills you should have** -------------------------- **Must-Have qualifications for this role are:** * **Experience:** Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in Anti-Financial Crime, Compliance, Audit, or Risk Management within the financial/banking sector. * **Subject Matter Expertise:** Strong understanding of AML/CTF, Sanctions. * **Control Testing Skills:** Proven track record in executing control testing, quality assurance reviews, or compliance monitoring methodologies. * **Analytical Mindset:** Strong data-handling and analytical capabilities, with the ability to identify anomalies, evaluate control effectiveness, and summarize findings clearly for senior management.. While advanced technical skills are not required, a risk-based mindset and the ability to translate data into meaningful risk insights are essential * **Languages**: **Fluency in is essential**. Knowledge of Polish, French, German or Spanish is considered a strong advantage. **What we offer** ----------------- You will get an opportunity to work in an **innovative, digital bank** applying state of the art approaches and technologies. Unless limited by banking regulations we offer a **flexible form of contract**. You will be provided an **Individual Development Budget**, dedicated to enhancing your professional skills. If your role permits, we also offer **flexible work location**: home/office — according to your preference. You and your closest family will be covered with **VIP-level private medical care** which includes **dental treatment** and a **hospitalisation package**. We care for our colleagues’ well being, therefore we cover **psychological consultations** if you ever feel you need such support. We co-sponsor your **Multisport** card and cover **50%** of its cost. You will work on computer equipment that delivers the best user experience — **Apple MacBook**. Our office in Warsaw offers **healthy snacks** throughout the day. **Our process** --------------- We keep our recruiting process simple. **Step 1:** Talk with one of our Recruiters about your to date experiences and ambitions **Step 2:** Meet with your future Team Manager to deep dive on the role specifics and our work environment **Our note to you** ------------------- We are an equal opportunity employer. We stand together in nurturing a workplace that welcomes diverse thinking and inclusive behaviors. By embracing diversity of thought and making all voices heard regardless of background, we drive innovation, sustainable growth, and new business opportunities. This inclusive approach enhances our work climate, directly boosting our people's productivity, well-being, and engagement. Our Values - **Integrity, Ownership, Caring** - are more than just words. They are actions. Mandates. Pledges. When we all commit to these shared Values, we will deliver for our clients. And delivering for our clients - in any way, large or small - is how we fulfil our Purpose. If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply - even if you're not 100% sure. We are interested in getting to know you and learning about what you bring to the table.We appreciate your time and application. Please note that we reserve the right to contact selected candidates. Good luck! **About us** ------------ Read more about what we do on our LinkedIn profile.
