description: At Media Miami, we believe every brand has a story worth telling—and we’re here to turn that story into something powerful, memorable, and impactful. We operate as a specialised team of A-players who move fast, think strategically, and take ownership. We’re not about bureaucracy—we're about execution, growth, and doing meaningful work that drives real outcomes. **Role Overview** We are looking for a hands-on **Automation & Infrastructure Engineer** to build, maintain, and continuously improve the technical infrastructure behind our growing digital publishing and newsletter operation. This is not a traditional DevOps role and not a purely operational support position. We need someone who can understand a manual workflow, work through it when necessary, and then turn it into a reliable, scalable system using code, APIs, automation tools, and AI. As the number of newsletters, domains, accounts, and operational workflows grows, your responsibility will be to reduce manual work, improve reliability, and build technical systems that allow the operation to scale without increasing headcount at the same rate. We are looking for someone who can turn unclear operational problems into reliable technical solutions, troubleshooting unfamiliar systems independently in a fast-changing environment where not every process is documented. You will bring a strong focus on edge cases, logging, error handling, and data integrity to everything you build. **Key Responsibilities** **Automation & Integrations** * Build and maintain automations for recurring operational workflows * Integrate internal and third-party systems using APIs, webhooks, and custom scripts * Build workflows in n8n and similar automation platforms * Develop lightweight internal tools and utilities using Python and/or Node.js/TypeScript * Integrate LLMs and AI agents into internal workflows where they provide measurable value **Infrastructure & Platforms** * Configure and maintain domains and DNS records, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, TXT, and A records * Work with Cloudflare and other domain/infrastructure management tools * Work with newsletter platforms, ESPs, CRM systems, and publishing tools * Automate account creation, configuration, status tracking, and operational checks where possible * Work with databases and structured operational data **Reliability, Improvement & Collaboration** * Build monitoring, alerts, validation checks, retries, and error-handling mechanisms * Troubleshoot technical issues across APIs, domains, integrations, accounts, and automation workflows * Identify repetitive manual work and propose technical solutions to eliminate or reduce it * Maintain clear technical documentation for systems and automations * Collaborate closely with Operations, Marketing, QA, and other internal specialists **Requirements** **Must Have** * 1+ year of strong hands-on experience with Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or a similar backend/scripting language * Experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, and third-party integrations * Experience with proxies, isolated browser environments, or large-scale account operations * Understanding of databases and ability to work with SQL * Practical experience with LLM APIs, AI agents, structured outputs, tool/function calling, or AI-powered automation * Basic infrastructure knowledge: domains, DNS, HTTP, authentication, servers, networking concepts **Nice to Have** * Experience with Cloudflare, cPanel, AWS Route53, or similar tools * Experience with newsletter platforms or ESPs such as Ghost, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, etc. * Practical experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar — including automations that go beyond simple no-code workflows * CRM integration experience * Social media account creation and boosting * Experience managing large numbers of accounts, domains, or digital properties * Experience building internal admin panels, dashboards, or operational tools * Previous experience in digital publishing, affiliate marketing, e-commerce, or marketing technology **What Success Looks Like** You will not be measured by how many repetitive tasks you can perform manually. You will be successful if, over time: * Fewer workflows require manual intervention * Recurring operational tasks become automated and standardized * Technical incidents are detected earlier * New newsletters and accounts can be launched faster * Systems are documented and maintainable * The operation can scale significantly without a proportional increase in manual work **Who We're Looking For** You will probably enjoy this role if your natural reaction to a repetitive process is: “I can do this manually first, understand how it works, and then build something so we don’t have to keep doing it manually.” We're looking for someone who: * Is a curious, pragmatic builder who takes ownership * Is comfortable moving between code, APIs, automation platforms, infrastructure, and business operations * Understands unfamiliar systems quickly, experiments, and builds reliable solutions * Solves problems independently and thinks about business impact * Thrives in a fast-paced environment * Pays close attention to detail * Is eager to grow alongside the company You do not need to know every tool we currently use. We care much more about your ability to learn fast and build things that work. **Professional Growth** * International and multicultural environment * Career development opportunities * Learning resources and corporate library * Work alongside a high-performing team * Access to modern tools and technologies **Benefits** * Competitive salary * Paid vacation days * Paid sick leave days * Team events and activities * Paid English courses * Multisport card **Working Environment** * Modern office in Poland * Complimentary snacks, drinks, and office perks * Friendly and supportive team Job Type: Full-time Work Location: Remote

title: AR Process Consultant
description: **Your responsibilities:** ========================== * take global functional ownership of Accounts Receivable (AR) processes within the Order-to-Cash (O2C) value chain, driving harmonization, standardization and continuous improvement across Miele's international organizations; * act as a central subject matter expert for international business units, resolving complex AR-related process and system issues and ensuring alignment with global standards; * analyze business requirements, translate them into functional specifications and coordinate SAP enhancements from solution design through implementation, testing and release management; * collaborate with IT and other process owners to develop and optimize SAP-based solutions, including system integrations, Fiori applications and process automation; * take functional responsibility for AR processes in international SAP rollouts, transformation and migration projects, ensuring consistent implementation while addressing local requirements; * contribute to the design and improvement of cross-functional Finance processes, including payment management, bank accounting, commission processing and self-billing; * drive digitalization and automation initiatives, particularly in automated payment matching and bank-related processes, ensuring scalable and sustainable solutions; * coordinate end-to-end process testing, including System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), to ensure solutions meet business requirements; * work closely with international stakeholders across Finance, Sales, Treasury, Controlling and IT, as well as external partners, to support effective project delivery and issue resolution; establish and maintain process governance, documentation and knowledge sharing, supporting operational readiness and sustainable adoption of global AR solutions. **Our requirements:** ===================== * extensive professional experience in Accounts Receivable, Order-to-Cash processes, SAP Finance or a comparable finance process management role within an international organization; * deep functional knowledge of SAP FI, including receivables management, incoming payments, payment clearing, bank statement processing, dunning and collections; * strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes, accounting principles and integration points between AR, FI/CO, Sales, Treasury and other business functions; * proven experience in business process design, harmonization and standardization, ideally across multiple countries or SAP system landscapes; * practical experience in SAP implementations, international rollouts, system migrations or finance transformation projects; * ability to translate complex business requirements into functional specifications, collaborate with SAP specialists and manage system enhancements, including testing and release activities; * understanding of SAP configuration, system integrations and automation; experience with SAP Fiori, automated payment matching or related Finance solutions would be an advantage; * strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to identify root causes and develop sustainable process and system improvements; * excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate international teams, bridge business and technical perspectives and take ownership of complex topics; * university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; * very good English language skills; German language skills would be an advantage.

description: **Who we are looking for** The ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, Vice President, is part of the Global ETF Research team. The role is responsible for developing and delivering customized portfolio analytics that help clients understand how portfolios are constructed, where vulnerabilities may be present, and how different investment solutions can support specific portfolio objectives. The position combines portfolio diagnostics, asset allocation research, analytical tool development, and client-specific investment analysis. It covers both proprietary and non-proprietary funds and evaluates products according to the role they may play within a broader portfolio. The role has a specific focus on: * Customized portfolio analytics and portfolio construction insights, * Strategic and tactical asset allocation analysis across asset classes, regions, factors, and investment styles, * Assessment of portfolio vulnerabilities, including concentration, unintended exposures, diversification gaps, drawdown sensitivity, liquidity considerations, and other sources of risk, * Evaluation of how proprietary and non-proprietary funds may serve different portfolio roles, such as core exposure, diversification, risk mitigation, income, liquidity management, or targeted return enhancement, * Development and maintenance of scalable analytical tools, methodologies, and client-ready portfolio diagnostics, * Leadership, quality oversight, and development of junior team members. You will translate complex portfolio findings into clear, commercially relevant insights and collaborate with marketing, product, and investment teams to support client engagement and business priorities. The successful candidate will combine strong investment judgment with quantitative and communication skills. They will be able to move from portfolio-level diagnosis to practical asset allocation considerations, explain the interaction between holdings and exposures, and identify how individual funds can contribute to a coherent portfolio solution. **Why this role is important to us** The team you will join is part of State Street Investment Management, one of the world's largest asset managers, serving governments, institutions, and financial advisors globally. With more than four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer a broad range of investment solutions across asset classes, risk profiles, regions, and investment styles. As pioneers in index investing and ETFs, we continue to develop new ways to help investors build portfolios. Clients increasingly need analysis that goes beyond selecting an individual fund. They need to understand how exposures interact at the portfolio level, whether diversification is effective, where risk may be concentrated, and which implementation choices are most appropriate for their objectives and constraints. High-quality portfolio analytics can turn fund-level data into actionable portfolio construction insights and is an important capability supporting the growth of our ETF business. Join us if you are ready to make an immediate impact by helping clients identify portfolio vulnerabilities, evaluate asset allocation choices, and use investment products more effectively within complete portfolios. **What you will be responsible for** **Customized portfolio analytics and portfolio diagnostics:** * Lead the design and delivery of customized analyses for client portfolios, model portfolios, and strategic sales opportunities, * Assess portfolio structure across asset classes, regions, sectors, factors, currencies, investment styles, and underlying holdings, * Identify potential vulnerabilities, including concentration risk, overlapping exposures, unintended factor tilts, diversification gaps, drawdown sensitivity, liquidity constraints, and dependence on individual market outcomes, * Apply scenario analysis, stress testing, risk decomposition, performance attribution, correlation analysis, and other relevant methods to explain portfolio behavior, * Translate analytical findings into clear observations, trade-offs, and implementation considerations for clients and internal stakeholders, * Produce the Portfolio Insights and Analysis output, providing an in-depth assessment of portfolio construction, areas of weakness, potential risk, and opportunities to improve portfolio resilience. **Asset allocation and portfolio construction strategies:** * Evaluate strategic and tactical asset allocation approaches in the context of client objectives, investment horizons, risk tolerances, liquidity needs, and implementation constraints, * Analyze how changes in asset allocation may affect portfolio risk, return drivers, diversification, and sensitivity to market scenarios, * Develop analytical frameworks that connect macroeconomic and market views with portfolio exposures and possible implementation choices, * Assess the role of different building blocks within a total portfolio, including core beta, active, factor, fixed income, liquidity, income, alternatives, and risk-management exposures, * Support the development of portfolio construction methodologies, model-based analyses, and repeatable frameworks for common client use cases. **Fund roles and implementation analysis:** * Evaluate both State Street and third-party funds according to their potential function within a portfolio, * Analyze how different funds may provide core exposure, diversification, downside mitigation, income, liquidity, inflation sensitivity, duration management, factor exposure, or targeted growth opportunities, * Assess implementation trade-offs using holdings, returns, risk, liquidity, portfolio fit, and other relevant characteristics, * Use competitive and market analysis selectively to frame available implementation choices and explain material differences between approaches, * Provide data and analysis for client requests, including holdings, return streams, portfolio characteristics, risk measures, exposure analysis, and other relevant outputs. **Analytical tool and methodology development:** * Maintain and enhance existing portfolio analytics tools using in-house capabilities and third-party data or technology platforms, * Develop scalable tools that support both repeatable high-volume analysis and detailed bespoke work for significant commercial opportunities, * Create robust methodologies for portfolio diagnostics, vulnerability assessment, asset allocation analysis, fund-role classification, and implementation comparison, * Improve workflow efficiency, data quality, methodological consistency, and the clarity of client-ready outputs, * Evaluate relevant external analytical capabilities where they can strengthen portfolio analysis or improve the client experience. **Commercial and stakeholder support:** * Partner with sales, ETF specialists, and investment strategists to understand client needs and define the most relevant analytical approach, * Design targeted portfolio analyses that support specific client conversations and commercial opportunities, * Serve as a subject matter expert for portfolio analytics, portfolio construction, asset allocation, and ETF-related RFPs and DDQs, * Present complex findings in a concise and accessible way for technical and non-technical audiences, * Collaborate with product, marketing, investment, and technology teams to align analytical capabilities with client needs and business priorities. **Leadership and quality oversight:** * Train and develop junior team members in portfolio analytics, investment interpretation, tool usage, and communication of findings, * Allocate and prioritize work across the team, balancing recurring deliverables with bespoke client opportunities, * Review analytical outputs for methodological soundness, accuracy, relevance, and claritt, * Ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time, * Promote consistent analytical standards, documentation, and effective knowledge sharing. **What we value** These skills will help you succeed in this role: * Excellent quantitative, portfolio analysis, and investment interpretation skills, * Strong understanding of portfolio construction, asset allocation, diversification, risk decomposition, scenario analysis, and performance drivers, * Ability to identify portfolio vulnerabilities and distinguish material risks from less decision-relevant observations, * Ability to evaluate funds as portfolio building blocks and explain how different exposures may serve different investor objectives, * Experience designing analytical frameworks, automating processes, and developing scalable tools, * Strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy when working under pressure, * Ability to prioritize work, exercise sound judgment, and meet tight deadlines, * Ability to communicate technical analysis clearly in writing, presentations, and client discussions, * Good understanding of the global ETF and fund landscape, investment implementation choices, and relevant distribution channels, * Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience extracting meaningful insights from large and complex data sets is essential, * Ability to guide less experienced team members and develop their analytical skills, * Collaborative, self-motivated, intellectually curious, and comfortable working independently, automation tools, * Knowledge of investment risk, market structure, liquidity, and portfolio implementation considerations, * Awareness of current market and economic issues and their potential description: We're a group of DTC brands selling in the US, mostly on Meta, with Google, TikTok and YouTube behind it. Q4 is our biggest quarter. You iterate on what spends and drop what dies. * Our own creative generation tool is in build. Image ads now, video next. Links, not a CV. * Premiere or DaVinci at speed. CapCut for trend formats. * English copy a US shopper reads as native. Hooks, captions, a script when the brief only gives an angle. * 4 hours a day overlapping with UK time. Async the rest of the day. * EU Timezone **Benefits** ------------ * Short loop. Brief to live ad in days, and you see the result, so every week you know what worked. * Full data access. Your ads, your numbers, same dashboard the media buyers use. * One scorecard, updated every Monday, visible to you. You don't fund our ads. * Reply within 3 working days. No test task. One call where you show your work, then a decision. * The editor who learns the generation tool best runs video on it as it grows.
